title: [Client] wants a foothold in the emerging digital space without major cannibalization

objectives.text: Develop a new business model centered on a digital marketplace to secure competitive advantage going forward.
Create a foothold in the emerging digital space and open new revenue streams without major cannibalization or short-term loss.
Develop and scale the marketplace with minimal cannibalization and keep strategic control without losing speed.
Scale globally quickly by leveraging existing assets and make sure learnings flow back into the parent organization.
